metas.name: Annihilation
metas.description: Directed by Alex Garland (Ex Machina), this psychological sci-fi horror features intense dread, mind-bending concepts, and deeply unsettling themes.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: Like Exam and It's What's Inside, this is a low-budget, high-concept thriller where a dinner party spirals into reality-bending paranoia.

metas.name: The Invitation
metas.description: An agonizingly tense psychological thriller set in a single house that perfectly matches your appreciation for slow-burn tension and mystery.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A dark, gritty, and intensely cynical look at media sensationalism that aligns with the high-stakes thrills of Gone Girl and Sicario.

metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: Directed by Denis Villeneuve (Sicario), this gripping crime thriller explores moral compromise under extreme duress with a massive emotional weight.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: A slow-burn atmospheric horror movie with a thick sense of dread and religious paranoia, ideal for fans of The Others.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: An intense, black-and-white psychological drama starring Willem Dafoe and Robert Pattinson that delivers the same level of prestige intensity as The Master.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: A brilliant, cerebral science fiction film that prioritizes intellectual complexity and emotional gravity over spectacle, appealing to fans of Ex Machina.

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: A masterfully crafted horror-thriller that leverages silence to build unbearable tension, matching your taste for high-stakes survival like 28 Days Later.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: David Fincher's meticulous obsession-driven crime mystery captures the procedural brilliance seen in both Gone Girl and Conclave.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A razor-sharp dark comedy thriller that satirizes high society, satisfying the craving for dark humor and tense class-conscious narratives.

metas.name: Her
metas.description: A melancholy and philosophical sci-fi romance that examines artificial intelligence and human isolation, serving as a softer counterpart to Ex Machina.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: A gritty, incredibly intense dystopian masterpiece with stunning camerawork that matches the chaotic survival of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: A grim, high-stakes thriller featuring an iconic villain, matching the relentless, unforgiving tone of Sicario.

metas.name: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
metas.description: Yorgos Lanthimos' absurdly dark, unsettling psychological thriller delivers a clinical, tense atmosphere reminiscent of Ex Machina.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: An intimate, claustrophobic thriller that thrives on the mystery of who is telling the truth, appealing directly to fans of Exam.

metas.name: The Sunset Limited
metas.description: A profound, purely dialogue-driven philosophical debate about life and faith, perfect for fans of My Dinner with Andre.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description: An uncompromisingly complex, highly-detailed sci-fi mystery that challenges viewers to piece the narrative together, like The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
metas.description: A dark, atmospheric mystery with prestige direction from David Fincher that provides the same gritty crime aesthetic as Gone Girl.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description: An atmospheric, existential sci-fi horror film with a lingering sense of dread and a highly artistic presentation.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: Reuniting the cast of In Bruges, this melancholic dark comedy-drama blends sharp wit with heartbreaking existential themes.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description: Paul Thomas Anderson's epic study of greed and ambition features a monumental central performance, matching the prestige weight of The Master.

metas.name: Identity
metas.description: A rainy, claustrophobic whodunit horror-thriller that constantly subverts expectations, matching the vibe of Exam and The Others.

metas.name: Searching
metas.description: A high-concept, fast-paced modern mystery thriller that hooks the audience instantly, similar to the suspense of Gone Girl.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: A meticulously detailed, Oscar-winning investigation drama that shares the serious, high-stakes institutional drama of Conclave.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description: An intense, intellectually demanding look at faith, radicalization, and despair that shares themes with Conclave and The Master.

metas.name: Get Out
metas.description: A brilliantly layered social horror thriller with intense psychological elements and a constantly shifting sense of trust.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: Denis Villeneuve's devastating, beautifully directed mystery-drama is a gut-wrenching watch that demands absolute attention.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: Martin Scorsese's gothic psychological thriller is packed with paranoia, mystery, and tragic emotional complexity, reminiscent of The Others.

metas.name: Oldboy
metas.description: An intense, high-stakes mystery and revenge thriller with unmatched emotional brutality and unforgettable plot twists.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description: An isolated, deeply philosophical science fiction drama about identity and isolation, appealing to fans of Ex Machina.

metas.name: The Babadook
metas.description: A masterful psychological horror film where the supernatural threat is an agonizing metaphor for grief, matching The Others.

metas.name: Stalker
metas.description: An artistic and deeply philosophical masterpiece that explores human desire and belief in a mysterious, hostile environment.

metas.name: Green Room
metas.description: A brutal, high-intensity siege thriller about survival that will keep your heart rate elevated, fitting your love of visceral thrillers.

metas.name: Se7en
metas.description: A masterclass in bleak, atmospheric crime-thrillers with dark themes, representing the pinnacle of the mystery-thriller genre.

metas.name: Upgrade
metas.description: A slick, high-energy sci-fi thriller exploring cybernetic enhancement and AI control, matching the technology fears of Ex Machina.

metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description: Studio Ghibli's most devastating masterpiece; a serious, historically heavy war drama that connects to your appreciation for The Wind Rises.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: A mind-bending anime psychological thriller about identity loss, paranoia, and fame that predates and inspired masterpieces like Black Swan.

metas.name: The Hateful Eight
metas.description: A dialogue-heavy, tense chamber mystery set in a snowbound cabin, blending the high stakes of Exam with the historical flair of Inglourious Basterds.

metas.name: The Zone of Interest
metas.description: An chillingly quiet and deeply artistic historical drama that explores the banality of evil with immense technical and emotional precision.
